v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Cum compleréntur * dies Pentecóstes, erant omnes páriter in eódem loco, allelúia.
text.en: When the day of Pentecost was fully come * they were all with one accord in one place, alleluia.

text.la: Spíritus Dómini * replévit orbem terrárum, allelúia.
text.en: The Spirit of the Lord * filleth the world, alleluia.

text.la: Repléti sunt omnes * Spíritu Sancto, et cœpérunt loqui, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: They were all filled * with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Fontes, et ómnia * quæ movéntur in aquis, hymnum dícite Deo, allelúia.
text.en: See ye fountains, * and all that move in the waters, ascribe ye praise to God, alleluia.

text.la: Loquebántur * váriis linguis Apóstoli magnália Dei, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: The Apostles spoke in diverse tongues * the wonderful works of God, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Cum compleréntur dies Pentecóstes, erant omnes discípuli páriter in eódem loco: et factus est repénte de cælo sonus, tamquam adveniéntis spíritus veheméntis, et replévit totam domum, ubi erant sedéntes.
text.en: When the day of Pentecost was fully come, the disciples were all with one accord in one place and suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a rushing mighty wind and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

v.la: Repléti sunt omnes Spíritu Sancto, allelúia.
v.en: They were all filled with the Holy Ghost, alleluia.

text.la: Sic Deus * diléxit mundum, ut Fílium suum unigénitum daret: ut omnis, qui credit in ipsum, non péreat, sed hábeat vitam ætérnam, allelúia.
text.en: God so loved the world * that He gave His Only-begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in Him should not perish, but have everlasting life. Alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui Apóstolis tuis Sanctum dedísti Spíritum: concéde plebi tuæ piæ petitiónis efféctum; ut, quibus dedísti fidem, largiáris et pacem.
text.en: O God, Who didst give thine Holy Spirit unto thine Apostles, grant unto thy people the effectual fruit of their godly supplications, and as Thou hast given them faith, give them also peace.

office.title: Die II infra octavam Pentecostes Dies Octavæ
